decision: Do not create agent_run_events. Prefer kanban_task_events for task/run event recording; carry additional pickup/agent/trace correlation in its payload only after the correlation contract is approved.

linkageFindings.workflowTasks: uses uuid id/run_id and text request/trace correlation; not the proposed workspace_task_id contract
linkageFindings.taskSemanticPackets: uses integer workspace_task_id and integer packet/queue relationships in the active schema
linkageFindings.agentPickupQueue: uses text task_id plus integer workspace_task_id; not a stable uuid bridge to the proposed event table
linkageFindings.traceEvents: uses nullable uuid run_id and does not carry task or pickup identifiers
linkageFindings.kanbanTaskEvents: already provides task_id, run_id, event_type, payload, and created_at with an active task-board owner
linkageFindings.conclusion: No single existing table provides every proposed field, but kanban_task_events is the smallest existing owner for the core event record

nextGate: select one event owner and prove task/pickup/trace linkage without duplicate event recording
